newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks forecast to open higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks forecast to open higher.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to open higher on Thursday after weak May U.S. retail sales numbers cleared the way for a fifth day of records, analysts said.
Retail sales for the month of May fell 0.1 percent, the third consecutive monthly decline. Wall Street economists had expected to see an increase of 0.4 percent.
The long bond jumped 29/32 at a 6.77 percent yield while the S&P futures index was up 3.85 at 874.40.
"The bonds are way up, and the futures are up. It looks like we are going to have another rip-roaring day," said Alan Ackerman, market strategist at Fahnestock & Co.
